cds.title: California State University, Chico Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: CDS C1 fall 2025 first-year class (residency table: 22,542 applicants, 20,528 admits, 2,041 enrolled; 7 applicants and 1 admit had unknown residency). International applicants 239 and admits 150 (63%) is far lower than the overall admit rate of about 91%. Chico State has no waitlist and no early decision or early action. Undergraduate enrollment 13,599 and 145 nonresident undergraduates are the B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures. The CSU is test-blind: only 3% (69) of enrolled first-years submitted SAT and 0.5% (8) ACT, so score ranges are omitted. C7 factor 'standardized test scores' is marked very important in the CDS, which contradicts C8 (SAT/ACT not used), so that single factor is left out.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: SAT/ACT not used in admission decisions ('Not considered for admission, even if submitted'); scores are used only for math and English placement.
